split.final_training_policy: After model design and hyperparameters are frozen without official-task feedback, the final NCF may be retrained on synthetic supervision from all 1000 skills. The official 87 tasks remain untouched.

rationale.minimum_cosine: A source-only audit found that raw similar_to components contain a 608-skill generic automation giant component. A conservative 0.88 threshold leaves 64 high-confidence similar_to/specializes edges and source-only components no larger than 8 before alias merging.
rationale.family_split: All members of a near-duplicate family stay in one split. Candidate retrieval still ranks against all 1000 skills.
